in_sanskrit.name: सतिश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सतित्वम् (satitvam) - truth, ईशन् (ishan) - lord, सतिश (Sathish) - one who is the embodiment of truth

in_hindi.name: सतिश
in_hindi.meaning: सत्य (satya) - truth, ईश (ish) - lord, सतिश (Sathish) - one who is the embodiment of truth

in_tamil.name: சதிஷ
in_tamil.meaning: ஸத்யம் (sathyam) - truth, அரியர் (ariyar) - lord, சதிஷ (Sathish) - one who is the embodiment of truth

in_telugu.name: శతిష్
in_telugu.meaning: శద్య (shadhya) - truth, ఏశ (Ish) - lord, శతిష్ (Sathish) - one who is the embodiment of truth

in_marathi.name: Sathish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sathish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who embodies truth and reality

in_bengali.name: Sathish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Truth, Reality
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sathish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who embodies truth and reality
